patch:
@@ -77,8 +77,15 @@ runs:
         raco pkg show --scope user q || true
         echo ""
 
+        # raco pkg show exits 0 even when the package is absent (it prints
+        # "[none]"), so exit status cannot detect installation. Compare the
+        # trimmed output instead.
+        q_installed() {
+          [ "$(raco pkg show --scope user q 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')" != "[none]" ]
+        }
+
         if [ "${{ steps.racket-addon-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}" = "true" ]; then
-          if ! raco pkg show --scope user q >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          if ! q_installed; then
             echo "::error::Exact Racket cache hit lacks the q user package; bump the cache schema or repair ci/racket-package-lock.rktd. Reproduce locally with: racket scripts/ci-package-setup.rkt --preflight"
             exit 1
           fi
@@ -102,7 +109,7 @@ runs:
           # The pilot rollback runs after a producer that already link-
           # installed q into the shared user scope; relink instead of
           # failing on "package is already installed".
-          if raco pkg show --scope user q >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          if q_installed; then
             set +e
             raco pkg update --name q --link --batch --no-setup "$PWD"
             INSTALL_RC=$?

@@ -296,7 +296,7 @@ q/
 |--------|-------|
 | Test files | 1357 |
 | Source modules | 842 |
-| Source lines | 154130 |
+| Source lines | 154137 |
 | Test lines | 240720 |
 | Test assertions | 37058 |
 | Tests passing | 5835+ | `racket scripts/run-tests.rkt` results |

@@ -89,6 +89,13 @@
                                      [rel (path->string (find-relative-path base-dir f))])
                                 (and (string-suffix? s ".rkt")
                                      (not (string-contains? s "/compiled/"))
+                                     ;; v1.00.11 hotfix: the discovery-parity fixture tree
+                                     ;; (tests/metadata-discovery/fixture/) is frozen input
+                                     ;; data for tests/ci/metadata-discovery-test.rkt, which
+                                     ;; copies it into its own temp root before collecting.
+                                     ;; The repo-root walk must never collect or execute it.
+                                     (not (for/or ([prefix (in-list discovery-ignored-path-prefixes)])
+                                            (string-prefix? rel prefix)))
                                      (not (support-test-module? s))
                                      (not (hash-ref (get-file-metadata rel) 'not-test? #f))))))
          (path->string (find-relative-path base-dir f))))
